common.disclaimer: IMPORTANT MEDICAL DISCLAIMER: This AI screening output is a decision-support tool designed to assist health workers in identifying Diabetic Retinopathy. It does not provide a definitive medical diagnosis and does not replace evaluation by a qualified ophthalmologist.
common.medicalClarificationText: This application is a screening and clinical decision-support tool intended for patients already diagnosed with diabetes. It analyzes retinal fundus photos for signs of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR). It does NOT diagnose diabetes or replace an ophthalmologist.

recommendations.NO_DR: Routine annual follow-up according to standard clinical guidance for diabetic patients.
recommendations.MILD: Routine ophthalmologist follow-up recommended within 6 to 12 months.
recommendations.MODERATE: Ophthalmologist review recommended within 4 to 6 weeks for detailed fundus examination.
recommendations.SEVERE: Prompt ophthalmologist review recommended within 2 weeks.
recommendations.PROLIFERATIVE: Urgent ophthalmologist evaluation recommended immediately for anti-VEGF or laser treatment assessment.
